fields.description: Caller-facing key. Pass to `div_frappe_base.ocr.client.recognize(engine_name, ...)`. Seeded set: `default`.
fields.label: Engine Name

fields.description: Backend that turns an image into text lines. `PaddleOCR HTTP` / `Custom HTTP` POST the image to `base_url`; `Tesseract` runs pytesseract in-process; `Vision LLM` delegates to the named `AI Profile` via div_frappe_base.ai.client.
fields.label: Engine Type
fields.options:
PaddleOCR HTTP
Tesseract
Vision LLM
Custom HTTP

fields.description: Base URL of the OCR HTTP service (e.g. `http://localhost:8868`). See the div_frappe_base README § OCR service for the expected request/response contract.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: For `Vision LLM`: the AI Profile name (on AI Settings) to delegate recognition to, e.g. `vision`.
fields.label: AI Profile

fields.description: Language hint passed to the engine where supported.
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Drop recognized lines whose confidence falls below this (0–1). Engines that don't report confidence treat every line as 1.0.
fields.label: Min Confidence

fields.description: Optional. Sent as a Bearer token / `X-API-Key` header to HTTP engines that require auth.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Wall-clock cap in seconds for a single recognition call.
fields.label: Timeout (s)
